_reason: stage O3 typed `colsToSort` as an enum_ref to the 'ck ascending'/'ck descending' constants, but both syntax lines in CollectionClass.html declare it as `colsToSort : Collection`: the ck constants appear in the page's prose because they are used by .sort()/.order by, not as the value of this parameter. tool4d rejects `$c.multiSort(ck ascending)` with 'At least one parameter type does not match the prototype(s) of the function "multiSort".' An audit of all 45 enum_ref slots against their rawSyntax declared type found this as the only mismatch. Retyped to concrete Collection; rawSyntax untouched.
